propositions: rebar bridge fsck reports store_integrity=13 with 13 reverse_missing_forward audit findings for Jira keys REB-410 through REB-422, whose forward binding entries have been deleted
The 13 orphaned reverse keys all point to deleted ZZ-*TEST fixture tickets created under a retired environment (env_id ade0f2ef-...), not the current store's environment (01a1a015-...)

The reverse orphan leak occurs because BindingStore.unbind() only pops reverse entries when the forward entry still carries a jira_key, so deleting forward entries by other paths permanently orphans their reverse keys
The 13 orphaned reverse keys were successfully deleted from .bridge_state/bindings.json through BindingStore and commit_and_push_tickets_branch, reducing store_integrity from 13 to 0
The forward bindings map (2111 entries) and bindings-retired.json remained unchanged; reverse count dropped by exactly 13 to match forward count
After repair, rebar bridge fsck returns store_integrity=0 with all alerting binding_drift cells at 0, confirming the defect is resolved
